module_expected_types.GRWTSK.FourierAnalysis.FourierAnalysisIn:
∀ {ι : Type u} [Countable ι] (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → Complex)
  (f : ι → Real → Complex) (N : Nat) (x : Real),
  Finset.sum s (fun i => Norm.norm (w i)) ≤ 1 →
    Norm.norm ((Finset.sum s (fun i => w i * _root_.partialFourierSum N (f i) x)) -
      (Finset.sum s (fun i => w i * f i x))) ≤
        Finset.sum s (fun i => Norm.norm (_root_.partialFourierSum N (f i) x - f i x))

∀ {ι : Type u} [Countable ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Real → Complex)
  (hc : ∀ i, Continuous (f i))
  (hp : ∀ i, Function.Periodic (f i) (2 * Real.pi)),
  Filter.Eventually (fun x : Real =>
    ∀ ε : Real, 0 < ε → Filter.Eventually (fun N : Nat =>
      ∀ w : ι → Complex, Finset.sum s (fun i => Norm.norm (w i)) ≤ 1 →
        Norm.norm ((Finset.sum s (fun i => w i * _root_.partialFourierSum N (f i) x)) -
          (Finset.sum s (fun i => w i * f i x))) < ε) Filter.atTop)
    (MeasureTheory.ae (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure Real))

∀ {ι : Type u} [Countable ι] (s : Finset ι) (W : Nat → ι → Complex)
  (hW : ∀ N, Finset.sum s (fun i => Norm.norm (W N i)) ≤ 1)
  (f : ι → Real → Complex) (hc : ∀ i, Continuous (f i))
  (hp : ∀ i, Function.Periodic (f i) (2 * Real.pi)),
  Filter.Eventually (fun x : Real =>
    Filter.Tendsto (fun N : Nat =>
      Norm.norm ((Finset.sum s (fun i => W N i * _root_.partialFourierSum N (f i) x)) -
        (Finset.sum s (fun i => W N i * f i x)))) Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : Real)))
    (MeasureTheory.ae (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure Real))
